navigation.description: Start view and order of the entries per slot. A view is written <owner id>/<name>, without a leading slash.

start.description: The view `/` leads to; a sidebar entry is written <host id>/<host name>/<owner id>/<name>.

^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\\.[a-z0-9]+(-[a-.description: Order of the entries of the slot <owner id>.<name>: first the listed ones, then the rest by the fixed rule.

plugins.description: Switch per plugin; the keys are plugin ids (kebab-case). A plugin that is not listed is switched off.
